note: v614: cooler projector (heat, second pass). The film-grain overlay is off unless ?grain=1 (it was costing about 15-19 CPU points and 14-16 GPU points on the box, composited over the whole stage). A cool mode turns on by itself if the device cannot hold about 30 fps while in use: frames drop to about 20 fps, the cut float runs at half rate, and shadows and the small card bobs go (lifted after a minute of good frames, twice at most). Decorative card bobs also pause when idle or the tab is hidden; the video card still loops, and pauses only when hidden or off-screen. Other v612/v613 savings are unchanged.
